Home.title: Territory, agriculture, fermentation, research, and craft.
Home.description: This is the platform's foundation: accounts, profiles, and the permission system every other module — Commerce, Experiences, Partner Workspace, Research OS, Sensory, Competitions — will be built on top of. Explore the projects, places, stories, products, and experiences already available.

Sensory.error_judge_profile_missing: The judge profile is missing from the catalogue.
Sensory.scoreComputedHint: The total score is computed from what you mark below.
Sensory.error_responses_incomplete: Some attribute is unscored. The total score needs all eight.

Sensory.externalReportHelp: The result a Q grader or roaster delivered, under their own signature. That person has no account here: the report is filed in their name.

Sensory.externalReportEvaluatorHelp: If they are not listed, create them as a person first; their certification shows next to the name.
Sensory.externalReportSourceHelp: The PDF, the email, the scanned sheet. Without it the score cannot be checked again.
Sensory.externalReportDateLabel: Cupping date (if the report gives one)
Sensory.externalReportScoresHelp: Leave blank whatever the report does not carry; a 0 would claim it was scored at the minimum.
Sensory.externalReportCupsHelp: As the report marks them. Blank means it does not say, which is not the same as zero.
Sensory.externalReportTotalComputed: This protocol computes the total from the attributes: it is not typed.
Sensory.externalReportNoPeople: No registered person could have signed the report.
Sensory.error_source_reference_required: Say where the report's original lives.
Sensory.error_unknown_attribute: The protocol has no attribute “{attribute}”. Either the report follows another standard, or the attribute is missing from the protocol.

Traceability.lotsIntro: Active operations, and every lot you can see.
Traceability.createLotIntro: A Lot only ever comes into existence through a Harvest, a Receiving, or a processing step — never created blank.
Traceability.noLots: No lots match this filter yet.
Traceability.sinAmbitoHeading: You do not have access to any lot yet
Traceability.sinAmbitoBody: This does not mean the farm is empty: it means your account has no assignments yet. An administrator can grant them.
Traceability.sinAmbitoGestionBody: This does not mean there is no work on the farm: your account has no assignments that allow managing lots. An administrator can grant them.
Traceability.soloLecturaEnEsteLote: You can see this lot, but you cannot record work on it.
Traceability.noProcessing: No fermentation, drying, or storage recorded yet.
Traceability.noTimeline: Nothing recorded for this lot yet.
Traceability.noSamples: No samples taken from this lot yet.
Traceability.error_upload_failed: The photo upload failed. Please try again.
Traceability.originUnknown: Origin unknown — no harvest or receiving event found in this lot's lineage.
Traceability.lineageNone: This lot has no recorded ancestors or descendants.
Traceability.noTasks: No tasks for this lot's project.
Traceability.originLotConditionsIntro: Terrain conditions recorded for this lot's origin plot.
Traceability.noOriginLot: No origin plot recorded for this lot yet.
Traceability.plotsIntro: Terrain plots across your farms, with recorded growing conditions.
Traceability.listTruncated: Showing the {limit} most recent. There are more records than this list can hold.
Traceability.materialConsumptionHint: Yeast, culture, lime, nutrient, biochar. Note the lot number on the package: it is the one thing you cannot recover once the sack is thrown away.
Traceability.targetsIntro: What the recipe asked for, against what was measured. The readings are kept; the mean is calculated from them.
Traceability.targetsSingleReadingAmbiguous: a single reading cannot be both initial and final
Traceability.recipeHint: Optional. If you pick one, the page will compare what is measured against its targets.
Traceability.recipesIntro: What a fermentation should reach. Pick a recipe when starting a run, and the lot page compares what is measured against its targets.
Traceability.recipesEmpty: No recipes yet. Create one and you will be able to attach it to fermentations.
Traceability.recipeNewIntro: A name and at least one target. Version 1 is created with it; changing targets later creates a new version rather than rewriting what earlier runs were aiming for.
Traceability.recipeTargetsIntro: An exact value, a range, or both. The unit comes from the variable and is not typed.
Traceability.error_target_needs_a_number: Each target needs a value or a range.
Traceability.error_range_inverted: The minimum cannot be greater than the maximum.
Traceability.error_unknown_variable: That variable is not in the registry.
Traceability.error_wrong_unit_for_variable: The unit does not match the variable.
Traceability.error_target_out_of_physical_range: The value is outside that variable's physical range.
Traceability.error_organization_has_no_lots: That organization has no lots yet.
Traceability.recipeMetadataIntro: The label only. Targets are not edited: changing them creates a new version, so what earlier runs were aiming for is not rewritten.
Traceability.recipeNewVersionIntro: Starts from the current targets. Adjust what changes and save: the previous version is untouched and the runs that used it keep comparing against it.
Traceability.recipeVersionNotesPlaceholder: raised the target pH after the March cupping
Traceability.recipeHistoryIntro: Each version with its targets, and how many runs were operated against it.
Traceability.error_duplicate_variable_and_moment: Two targets share the same variable and moment.
Traceability.selectionHint: Sort the cherry and record each stream with its weight. Rejects become real lots — they can be stored, sold or reprocessed.
Traceability.selectionNoLedgerHint: This lot has no recorded weight yet — enter what the scale says.
Traceability.selectionRejectedHint: Each stream needs a category, a code and a weight. A row with no weight is ignored.
Traceability.noCohorts: No plantings recorded for this plot yet.
Traceability.densityMissingArea: Cannot be computed: the plot has no area in hectares.
Traceability.densityBadArea: Cannot be computed: the recorded area is not a positive number.
Traceability.densityMissingCount: Cannot be computed: {cohorts} planting(s) in this plot have no plant count.
Traceability.densityNoCohorts: Cannot be computed: this plot has no active plantings.
Traceability.densityComputedNote: Computed when shown, from the count and the area. Not stored, so it cannot go stale when either input is corrected.
Traceability.plotAttributesIntro: Everything is optional. What you leave blank stays “Not recorded”, which is not the same as zero. The area in hectares is what makes density and yield per hectare computable.
Traceability.harvestSourcesHeading: Which plots did this come from?
Traceability.harvestSourcesIntro: Each row is a plot that contributed cherry to this harvest. Contributions are ADDED to whatever is already recorded — this does not replace it. If a plot contributed but nobody weighed it separately, leave the weight blank: that records as unknown, not as zero.
Traceability.harvestSourcesNone: No contributing plots recorded for this harvest yet.
Traceability.harvestSourcesNoDeclaredWeight: This harvest has no declared weight, so there is nothing to reconcile against.
Traceability.harvestSourcesUnweighedWarning: {count, plural, one {1 recorded contribution has no weight} other {# recorded contributions have no weight}}: their cherry is NOT in this sum, so the difference overstates what is actually missing.
Traceability.harvestSourcesHiddenWarning: {count, plural, one {1 contribution is not visible with your permissions} other {# contributions are not visible with your permissions}}: they are not in this sum either.
Traceability.cohortCreateSummary: Record a planting in this plot
Traceability.cohortCreateIntro: Everything except “how this is known” is optional. What you leave blank stays not recorded, which is not the same as zero.
Traceability.cohortEditIntro: This corrects what was written down; it does not say the plot changed. The previous value stays in the audit record.
Traceability.cohortReasonPlaceholder: e.g. counted the plot and it is 812, not 833
Traceability.plantedPrecisionLabel: How precisely is the date known?
Traceability.dataQualityNone: No marker (no reason to doubt it)
Traceability.yieldNoHarvests: No harvest has been attributed to this plot yet. Attribution happens on the lot's harvest, under “Which plots did this come from?”.
Traceability.yieldUnweighedNote: plus {count} unweighed contribution(s): the total is a floor
Traceability.yieldComputedNote: By harvest calendar year. Computed when shown, from the per-plot contributions and the area; not stored, so it cannot go stale when either input is corrected.
Traceability.fieldSessionsNone: No field sessions recorded at this site yet.
Traceability.fieldSessionStartIntro: A session groups what happened on one outing: who went, when, and what was observed. It does not replace inspections or colony events — it threads them.
Traceability.fieldSessionClosedNoMoreEvents: This session is closed; no more events can be added.
Traceability.fieldEventsNone: Nothing recorded in this session yet.
Traceability.fieldEventOperatorLabel: Who (if not the person who opened the session)
Traceability.fieldEventQueuedOffline: Saved on this device. No signal: it will be sent when you sync.
Traceability.fieldEventQueueFailed: Could not save on this device. Do NOT leave this screen: press “Record” again.
Traceability.fieldSyncPending: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing waiting to send} one {1 note not sent} other {# notes not sent}}
Traceability.fieldSyncDone: {applied, plural, =0 {Nothing new to send} one {1 note sent} other {# notes sent}}
Traceability.fieldSyncRejected: {count, plural, one {1 note was refused by the server} other {# notes were refused by the server}}. Look at them: retrying will not fix them.
Traceability.fieldSyncUnavailable: Could not send: the server did not respond. What you recorded is still here, untouched, and can be retried.
Traceability.fieldDraftsPurged: {count, plural, one {1 unsent note was deleted} other {# unsent notes were deleted}} after more than {dias} days on this device.
Traceability.fieldDraftsStale: {count, plural, one {1 note has been} other {# notes have been}} unsent for more than {dias} days. They are deleted after {purga}.
Traceability.fieldSyncOffline: Offline. What you recorded is stored here and will be sent when signal returns.
Traceability.coordinatesUnavailable: Could not get the location. The session is saved without coordinates.
Traceability.correctionIntro: The original reading ({variable}: {value} {unit}) is NOT deleted: it stays in the record marked as superseded. This creates a new reading that supersedes it.
Traceability.correctionOccurredAtLabel: When the correct reading was taken
Traceability.correctionReasonPlaceholder: e.g. I wrote 24 and the instrument read 42
Traceability.biocharIntro: Every burn, documented with the Table 6 fields from the research framework. Without thermal regime, feedstock and charging recorded, “10 t/ha of biochar” describes a volume, not a treatment.
Traceability.biocharCodeHelp: The link between the material, the plot and every later measurement. Without it, results cannot be attributed.
Traceability.biocharProducedAtHelp: Where the kiln is, which is not where it will be applied. A batch is burned once and may be applied across several plots.
Traceability.biocharProducedOnHelp: Aging is derived from this: fresh char and weathered char behave differently.
Traceability.biocharFeedstockHelp: Type and proportions if mixed. It is the single largest determinant of final properties.
Traceability.biocharPeakTempHelp: Above 750 °C the sum of the 16 US EPA PAHs rises compared with the 450–600 °C range. It is recorded either way: the reading is the reading.
Traceability.biocharTempMethodHelp: A 550 from a thermocouple and a 550 estimated from flame colour are not the same claim.
Traceability.biocharOxygenHelp: How air was restricted, and how flame and smoke behaved. It is the variable separating pyrolysis from combustion.
Traceability.biocharStorageHelp: Where and how the material waited between burning and use.
Traceability.biocharChargingIntro: Determines whether the material acts as a nutrient carrier or a nutrient sink: uncharged biochar can adsorb soil nitrogen at first.
Traceability.biocharLabHelp: Which one only. The analysis results cannot be recorded here yet.
Traceability.biocharAgingUnknown: No production date, so this cannot be computed
Traceability.error_biochar: Could not save the biochar batch: {detail}
Traceability.biocharCharacterisationIntro: The Table 7 parameters. Without them the batch is documented but not characterised, and “10 t/ha” still describes a volume, not a treatment.
Traceability.biocharNoMeasurements: No analyses recorded for this batch yet.
Traceability.biocharUnitHelp: Filled with the parameter's canonical unit and editable: if the report comes in %, type % and the system converts.
Traceability.biocharSourceRefHelp: The laboratory report's number or name, so the paper can be found again.
Traceability.soilProfileIntro: The soil profile description. It needs no laboratory, and it is the only thing that tells a wet, well-structured soil — an asset — from a wet, compacted one, which is a ceiling no fertiliser programme lifts.
Traceability.soilNoProfiles: No soil pit described for this plot yet.
Traceability.soilPitDepthHelp: The framework asks for 80–100 cm where terrain allows. If rock stopped it earlier, record what was reached: that says something too.
Traceability.soilRootingDepthHelp: The single most important number for root health in this soil. Coffee fine roots concentrate near the surface, so a shallow constraint does disproportionate damage.
Traceability.soilAnaerobicIntro: The signs that the soil periodically runs out of air. Each has three answers, and “not recorded” is a fourth: “not looked for” and “looked for and absent” are not the same.
Traceability.soilImpedingDepthHelp: How deep the layer that blocks roots or water appears, if any. It is the number that decides whether the problem is drainage or nutrition.
Traceability.soilHorizonsIntro: From the surface downwards. Rows left blank are discarded.
Traceability.error_soil_profile: Could not save the soil pit: {detail}
Traceability.samplesIntro: The sample and the result are two different things: a sample leaves weeks before a number comes back, so first record that it was collected and then what the laboratory said.
Traceability.sampleTreatmentPlotHelp: Free text for now: the trial layout (T0–T4) is Step 8 and sampling happens before it.
Traceability.sampleSamplingPointHelp: The point's tag, so next year's round returns to the same place. Without it, a soil-chemistry series compares different spots and calls it change.
Traceability.sampleDepthHelp: The framework asks for roughly 0–20, 20–40 and 40–60. Two depths are never mixed in one sample.
Traceability.sampleSubSamplesHelp: 10–15 taken across the plot at the same depth, mixed. Never across treatments or depths.
Traceability.sampleExtractionHelp: Phosphorus is highly method-dependent: a Bray P and a Mehlich P do not compare.
Traceability.sampleProtocolIntro: Without this, year-to-year comparison means nothing: treatment differences are swamped by sampling noise.
Traceability.sampleLeafPairHelp: Counting down from the tip. The exact number is agreed with the laboratory and then never changed.
Traceability.samplePhenologyHelp: The usual reference timing is pre-flowering.
Traceability.sampleBearingLabel: The sampled branch was bearing fruit
Traceability.sampleProtocolComplete: Protocol complete: comparable with other rounds.
Traceability.sampleProtocolIncomplete: Protocol incomplete — {n} missing, so this sample is not comparable:
Traceability.landPhotosIntro: General photos of the plot, alongside those attached to a soil pit.
Traceability.biocharPhotosIntro: The retort and the process. Kiln design is a text field, and a photo says what no description reaches.
Traceability.recordRoastIntro: Logged once the roast is done. Only the roasted lot code and the start time are required; everything else is optional.
Traceability.roastProfileNoneChosen: No profile has been chosen for this lot yet.
Traceability.reportNoRecords: This visit was closed with no records.
Traceability.processIntro: One or more handling events before or during drying, up to the moisture % at which it will be stored.
Traceability.processIntentLabel: What is intended for this lot? (required)
Traceability.processIntentPlaceholder: 40 kg whole cherry, anaerobic natural 72 h
Traceability.processIntentHelp: Weight, material state, process type, hours. It can be changed later and the change is recorded.
Traceability.processIntentChangeHelp: The previous text is not lost: it stays in the audit trail with who changed it and when.
Traceability.processTargetMoistureLabel: Moisture % it will be stored at (required)
Traceability.processNoRecipeHelp: No recipe is fine: the intent above is what is required.
Traceability.processRunsAttached: Attached to this process: {fermentations} fermentation(s), {dryings} drying run(s).
Traceability.processNoMoistureYet: This lot has no moisture measurement yet. Record one before closing the process.
Traceability.processBlockedFromStorage: This lot closed above its target, so it cannot move to storage. Send it back to drying.
Traceability.processOpenAnotherHelp: The previous process is closed. Opening another is for reprocessing.
Traceability.error_lot_process: The process could not be recorded: {detail}
Traceability.processReportIntro: Each lot process with its intent, closing moisture, varietal, roast profile and the scores of the samples that came from it.
Traceability.processReportNothingYet: No process has been recorded yet, so there is nothing to compare. The report is not empty because of an error: it is waiting to be filled.
Traceability.processReportMethodNote: Simple mean of the total scores of submitted assessments. A dash means there are none, not that the value is zero.
Traceability.coordsSpread: readings spread up to {metros} m apart
Traceability.coordsAccuracy: best accuracy reported by the device: {metros} m
Traceability.coordsNoSamples: No visit has carried a GPS reading yet. One will be proposed as soon as someone opens a visit here.
Traceability.coordsDiffersFromDeclared: Note: what the visits propose is {metros} m from what is declared today.
Traceability.error_provenance_required: Choose where this datum comes from.
Traceability.error_provenance_not_offered: “{value}” is not a provenance this screen offers.
Traceability.reportEmitHelp: Freezes what this visit recorded. What is issued does not change if the data is corrected later: a new version is issued instead.
Traceability.reportLinkDaysHelp: Blank uses the default period. The link can be revoked earlier.
Traceability.reportLinkOnce: Shown once: the database keeps it hashed, not in the clear. If lost, publish another.
Traceability.error_visita_sin_completar: Close the visit before issuing its report.
Traceability.error_reporte_no_emitido: Issue the report before publishing its link.
Traceability.visitCompleteHelp: Ending the session says when you left the site. Completing it says you finished writing it up, and that is what unlocks the report.
Traceability.visitNextDueHelp: This is where the site dashboard's alert comes from. Whoever closes knows it; a calendar does not.
Traceability.visitColoniesAliveHelp: Without this number there is no way to see loss without replacement.
Traceability.visitCompleteReasonLabel: Why it was completed this way (optional)
Traceability.recipeEveryHoursHint: Optional. If the recipe does not declare it, the list cannot say whether the batch owes you a reading.
Traceability.recipeExpectedHoursHint: Optional. Tells whether a batch is running late in this phase.

Apiary.apiariesIntro: Hives, colonies, inspections, and honey harvests.
Apiary.sinAmbitoHeading: You do not have access to any apiary yet
Apiary.sinAmbitoBody: This does not mean there are none: it means your account has no assignments yet. An administrator can grant them.
Apiary.hiveCount: {count, plural, =0 {No hives} one {# hive} other {# hives}}
Apiary.noColonyYet: This hive has no colony recorded yet.
Apiary.irregularidadesVentana: Last 12 months. It does not say "season" because the project does not define one yet: when it does, this window follows it.
Apiary.irregularidadColonias: {colonias, plural, one {# colony} other {# colonies}}, {inspecciones, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}
Apiary.inspectionSavedLocally: Saved on this device — will sync when connected.
Apiary.localSaveFailedError: Could not save on this device. Check available storage and try again.
Apiary.noActivity: No inspections or events recorded yet.
Apiary.pendingCount: {count, plural, one {# entry waiting to sync} other {# entries waiting to sync}}
Apiary.erroredCount: {count, plural, one {# entry failed to sync} other {# entries failed to sync}}
Apiary.draftsPurgedNotice: {count, plural, one {# old unsynced draft was removed} other {# old unsynced drafts were removed}} to protect field data if this device is lost.
Apiary.listTruncated: Showing the {limit} most recent. There are more records than this list can hold.
Apiary.labelsIntro: One per box ({count}). Stick it where it shows with the lid on.
Apiary.alerta_perdida_sin_reposicion: Colonies were lost and have not been replaced
Apiary.alerta_visita_vencida: The scheduled visit is more than 14 days overdue
Apiary.alerta_alimento_vencido: Feed ran out and there is no newer feeding
Apiary.alerta_alimento_por_vencer: Feed runs out in less than 7 days
Apiary.alerta_visita_sin_cerrar: A visit has been left open for more than 72 hours
Apiary.mapaSinCoordenadas: {count, plural, one {One site is not on the map: nobody has declared where it is.} other {# sites are not on the map: nobody has declared where they are.}} Declare it from each site's page.
Apiary.vitalesPendientes: Two dashboard vitals are still missing: pollination density (needs committed hectares) and 7-day weather (needs a connected provider). Neither is estimated.
Apiary.pollinationCountSource_sistema: The count comes from colonies active in the system, not from the one made on leaving the site. The two can differ.
Apiary.pollinationCountSource_declarado_en_visi: The count is the one made on leaving the site during the last visit.
Apiary.pollinationCountDiverges: Note: the visit counted {declarado} colonies and the system has {sistema}. Both numbers exist and they disagree.
Apiary.colonyEndWarning: This cannot be undone. It marks the colony as lost and it stops counting for the site.
Apiary.colonyEndReasonPlaceholder: what was seen: varroa, queenless, robbing…
Apiary.colonyEndCausesHelp: It can be more than one: an empty hive can be varroa and starvation at once. For each, say how you know — when recording a loss, suspecting is the normal case, not having seen it. "Unknown" is a legitimate answer, and it goes on its own.
Apiary.colonyEndSavedLocally: The loss was recorded on this device. It will be sent as soon as there is signal.
Apiary.apiaryCreateIntro: The site where the hives stand. Hives, colonies and visits hang off it afterwards.
Apiary.apiaryOrganizationHelp: Who the site belongs to. Without it the apiary has no owner.
Apiary.apiaryNoOrganizations: There is no farm you can hang an apiary from.
Apiary.varroaEvaluatesLabel: Does this evaluate an earlier treatment?
Apiary.varroaEvaluatesHelp: Pick one only if this count measures whether that treatment worked.
Apiary.varroaSavedLocally: Count saved on this device. It syncs when there is signal.
Apiary.varroaNoCounts: No varroa counts for this colony yet.
Apiary.queenCellsHelp: Emergency or swarm cells raise the site warning. “None” is data too: it says someone looked.
Apiary.pollenStoresHelp: A pollen shortage stops brood rearing before a nectar one does.
Apiary.droneBroodHelp: A sign of a laying worker if it appears with no queen.
Apiary.swarmWarningNone: No colony reported swarm cells in the window looked at.
Apiary.coverageUntilHelp: Estimated by whoever feeds. It is what raises the warning before it runs out.
Apiary.retirosAyuda: Strips left in generate resistance. Recorded here, not in the field.
Apiary.cajaAyuda: It changes rarely: recorded when it changes, not on every visit.
Apiary.cajaSinHistorial: This box's configuration has never been changed.
Apiary.ocupacionSinDenominador: {cubiertos} frames covered — not comparable without frames per box
Apiary.cierreCosechaAyuda: Weighed at extraction, not at the apiary.
Apiary.cierreCosechaRazon: Reason (only if you change something already recorded)
Apiary.humedadSinMedir: Not measured. Recorded as a lot measurement, not here: moisture is a refractometer reading with its instrument and provenance.

Research.intro: PE post-harvest protocols with controlled, isolated variables — create, version, and execute against a lot.
Research.externalIdentifierHint: Stored as-is. What the number encodes is not yet documented — ask the product owner before assuming a pattern.
Research.error_access: You don't have access to do that ({detail}).
Research.error_stage: That stage can't be completed yet ({detail}).

Content.title: Stories
Content.summary: {total} stories you can see, {live} live on the site.
Content.noStories: No stories you can see yet.
Content.newStoryIntro: A new story starts as an internal draft. Publishing it is a separate step.
Content.publishIntro: The public site shows a story only when it is approved AND public. That is why these are chosen together.
Content.publishWarning: Approved + public means readable by anyone on the internet.
Content.editingPublishedWarning: This story is already approved. Saving records the before and after in the audit trail.
Content.readOnly: You do not have permission to edit this story.
Content.error_no_content_access: You do not have access to this story.

ph.suspect_dilution: Suspicious reading: pH {ph}. Fresh mucilage does not exceed ~6.0 — this may be rinse water or the electrode out of the liquid.
ph.sensor_fault: Reading outside the measurable range ({ph}). It was saved, but it does not feed alerts: check the electrode.
ph.over_fermented_immediate: pH {ph}: below the immediate threshold. Over-fermentation damage is already happening.
ph.over_fermented: pH {ph}: entering over-fermentation. Take a look?
ph.stalled_rot_hazard: pH {ph} has not dropped after {hours} h. Rot hazard from stalling.
ph.kinetic_plateau: The pH curve has not moved for {hours} h, even though the value is in range. Take a look?
ph.approaching_low: pH {ph}: approaching the low limit. Get ready to wash.

brix.stagnation: °Brix has not dropped for {hours} h: fermentation looks stalled. Take a look?
brix.sensor_fault: °Brix reading outside the measurable range, or refractometer not zeroed. Saved, but it does not feed alerts.
brix.mixed_sample_points: The series mixes sample points and they are not comparable. Split them: there is no conversion between tank liquor and pressed mucilage.
brix.termination_ready: Sugars dropped as expected ({drop}%). The recipe suggests closing — the call is yours.
brix.data_integrity_violation: °Brix rose {rise} points with no recorded cause. Check the prism or log the enrichment.

balance.discrepancy_flagged: The balance is off by {kg} kg ({pct}%). Saved anyway — check the weighing when you can.
balance.gross_imbalance: The balance is off by {kg} kg ({pct}%). Saved as a draft; the lot will not advance until you review it.

drying.bean_temp: Bean temperature is {temp} °C, above the maximum. Lower the dryer.
drying.uneven: The bed is drying unevenly: {pp} points between the driest and wettest spot. Turn it before measuring again.
drying.over_dried: Moisture {pct} %: below the minimum. Sellable weight is lost and the bean cracks at hulling.
drying.target_reached: Moisture {pct} % and water activity {aw}: the lot meets both storage criteria.
drying.stalled: No drop for {hours} h above 20 % moisture. Mold hazard — take a look?
drying.rate_too_fast: Dropping {pp} points per day below 25 %. At that speed the surface seals and the core stays wet.
